title: b7z9.22.1: Rust beacon builder: emit slot_map in CBOR options
description: Add a beacon builder function in tdma_beacon.rs that serializes a slot_map (heapless::Vec<u8>) into the cbor_options field of the beacon wire format. Currently only parse_slot_map exists (tdma_beacon.rs:186-268). The builder must produce CBOR arrays matching the format parse_slot_map expects. Add unit tests round-tripping build->parse.
